notes.title: Join the Community!
notes.content: [p]Hello initiates![/p][p][/p][p]With our game nearly ready for release we would like to invite everyone to join our discord server! Here we will show sneak peaks of gameplay for release and future updates, take polls for what content should be added, and host giveaways for keys of the game and cosmetics. We are very grateful for the support you have given us so far and hope you will continue to support us by sharing your ideas and thoughts for our game![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/pZMfxwpGMN"]https://discord.com/invite/pZMfxwpGMN[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Once again thank you and we are excited to see you in the discord. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p][/p][p]Grimm Work Team[/p]
